title: Round-Differential Independence in Three-Round Xoodoo
summary: Dependence is prevalent among Rijndael-superbox trails, but whether it disappears in unaligned structures, especially three-round Xoodoo, remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: The vast majority of differential trails over the Rijndael superbox have dependent round differentials. Determine whether this dependence disappears under an unaligned round structure, specifically for differential trails over three-round Xoodoo.

scope.domain: Differential cryptanalysis of dependence among round differentials, with Rijndael as a baseline and unaligned Xoodoo as the concrete setting.
parameters: Three rounds — the fixed span of the Xoodoo differential trails under investigation
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the dependence effect disappears for unrestricted differential trails over three-round Xoodoo and for unaligned ciphers more broadly.

progress.summary: The authors expect the dependence effects seen in Rijndael to disappear in an unaligned cipher and investigate three-round Xoodoo. Independence is established only for the finite trail set examined, leaving the unrestricted Xoodoo and broader unaligned-cipher claims open.
citation_labels: Nicolas Bordes et al., Thinking Outside the Superbox
